title: Three-view orthographic character sheet with accessories
description: A 16:9 visual aid: front, side and back in A-pose plus the separable accessories laid out as isolated objects.

body.subject: A clean orthographic character sheet of {{character_description}}, 16:9 landscape, white background throughout, the same character in the same A-pose in every view with verifiably the same proportions and face.
body.action: Three views left to right: FRONT (left third, dead-on), SIDE (middle third, profile 90 degrees to the right, camera sees the character's left side), BACK (right third, directly away from the camera), feet on one ground line. To the right, the separable accessories as ISOLATED objects, each captioned with its name: {{accessory_list}}.
body.camera: Orthographic, no perspective, no foreshortening; eye-level; each view complete and uncropped.
body.style: Neutral diffuse flat lighting, no shadow on the ground, no cinematic mood; sharp focus, reference-grade clarity.
body.constraints: Match the reference exactly across all three projections; no overlapping views; if there are no accessories omit the accessory layout.

character_description.default: the character in the reference image
character_description.description: gender presentation if obvious, apparent age, art style, key wardrobe, key accessories, colour palette

accessory_list.description: every separable accessory, e.g. the wizard hat, the curved katana

negatives: no environment, shadow or rim lighting
